name: tcop-resource-map
description: Tencent Cloud resource discovery skill. Use it when enumerating resources from a resource map, searching cloud product instances, or listing instances that can be bound to an alarm policy — usually the first step before any metric, alarm or log investigation. 触发词：资源、资源地图、资源盘点、有哪些实例、实例列表、云产品实例、CVM、CDB、云服务器、 数据库实例、可绑定告警的实例、资源概览、按关键词搜实例、资源归属。 何时不触发：指标查询、告警历史、日志检索、链路分析等需要真实数据的场景不走本 Skill。
